problem_statement: v3.4 evaluated one arbitrary representative per ticket type, then effectively favored win bets; no reliable opportunity for attractive trifecta/exacta or permutations to reach purchase review.

generation.timing: Generate plausible orders and alternatives solely from frozen STEP1 plus course/pace/going scenarios before retrieving odds.
generation.trifecta: Explicitly consider ◎→○→▲, ◎→▲→○, ○→◎→▲, scenario-specific reversals and at least one supported △ in third when plausible. Do not force if no pre-race evidence, but report excluded alternatives.
generation.trio: Consider three different 3-horse sets around ◎○▲ and supported △/value competitors; exclude unsupported longshots.
generation.exacta: Evaluate both justified orderings, not favorite-first only.
generation.quinella_wide: Consider top-pair and at least one different pair from ability/track/pace evidence where possible.
generation.single_win_place: Compare top ability and price-divergent candidate(s) where possible.
generation.target_minimum_per_trifecta_trio: Three justified distinct market combinations when obtainable, else record candidate_generation_blocker; never fabricate odds.
generation.other_types: Two justified distinct combinations where obtainable, or document missing evidence.
generation.combinations_not_buy_bets: Exploratory candidate count is not final purchased ticket count.

probability.model: Full-field conditional finish events with provenance for each runner and all nine axes; separate scenarios and calibrated flag.
probability.factors: Ability, 1st/2nd/3rd order plausibility, class, course, going, pace, jockey, burden, recent form.
probability.risk_consistency: Apply same evidence/uncertainty standards to single and combination bets; do not reject simply because trifecta is high-variance or uncalibrated.

selection.primary_objective: Compare reward relative to assessed probability, downside sensitivity, scenario/horse support and budget; do not rank by highest hit-rate or highest point EV alone.
selection.decision: buy/pass for each race and all admissible types; top purchase point may be any of 8 types.
selection.no_value_reason: If priced and supported but reward does not justify risk, label value/risk, not information-unavailable.
selection.stake: normally 100 yen each, no automatic multi-leg wide spread or arbitrary bigger stakes
selection.calibration_warning: Candidate search inflates apparent best EV; apply uncertainty/multiple comparisons penalty and document limits rather than claiming profits.

data_contract.summary_rule: Eight legacy-compatible rows retain one best grounded representative per type; detailed list must contain its exact selection and odds.
data_contract.purchase_gate_rule: purchase_gate.candidates lists only the summary representative for each type as needed to preserve existing v3.4 compatibility; selection must match source row.
data_contract.candidate_search_audit: For each type show how many generated/evaluated/unpriced/excluded and why. Missing alternatives must not masquerade as confirmed global best.
data_contract.historical: Never edit v3.4 or earlier predictions, snapshots, proofs, reports, E2E benchmark, results or local-racing data.

testing: Synthetic positive trifecta price case, positive single-win case, no-value trifecta case, unpriced trifecta rejection, order swap/market mismatch rejection, legacy integrity check.
